name: The Horde Needs More Heavy Leather!
label: Quest
description: The Horde Needs More Heavy Leather!: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: It's true, adventurer, I still need more heavy leather. The requests from the generals and their quartermasters seem endless. And that's nothing compared to what the zeppelin masters are asking for!
I need to get my quota collected on the double. Friend, bring me more stacks of heavy leather as soon as you can!

clips.title: Completion
paras: You da mon, mon! Thank you so much for the heavy leather. Every little bit gets us that much closer. I'll just get these onto a pile so that the other leatherworkers can get to work on them.
Thanks again, friend, and if you come across more stacks of heavy leather, you know where you can find me.
